disabled.description: The action cannot be run, and the item takes no focus.

root.note: No face at rest. The item that has focus has a tint: it is the one marked row of the menu, moved by the keys and by the pointer.

keys.Enter: Runs the action at key down and closes the menu.
keys.Space: Runs the action at key up and closes the menu.

events.click: Dispatched once when the item is activated. Listen for it to run the action.

notYet: A disabled item still dispatches click to a listener the author adds; the menu ignores it.
